content: Soukohpo nin duwen Aramas me Sopohsang nan Apwal
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, ke wie koukousoan nanpwungen aramas kahngohdi kei. Mie pwoaren masarail, ahpw sohte mehkot re kilang; mie salengarail, ahpw sohte mehkot re rong, pwehki ar kahngohdi.

“Eri met, nein aramas, wahda omw koruk duwehte aramas emen me kin sopohsang nan apwal kin wia oh mweselda mwohn eh pahn wasa pwong. Aramas koaros en kilang omw pahn mweselda oh kolahng nan ehu wasa. Mweinele aramas kahngohdi pwuko pahn tehkuhkada.
Ni eh pahn rarahnte, ke pahn kihpene omw koruk en kalipilipala, pwe re en kak kilang uhk, oh re en kilang omw pahn mweselda nin soutik rasehng ma ke kalipilipala.
Nindokon ar pahn kilikilang, wiahda ehu pwoahr ni dihd en imwomwo oh duwaleisang nan ihmwo wa omw koruk en.

Re en kilang omw pahn kidahng omw koruk en pohn pwopwomw oh kohkohla nan roto perepere mesomwen, pwe ke en dehr kilang wasa me ke kohkohla ie. Dahme ke pahn wia iei kehkehlik ehu ong mehn Israel kan.”

Ngehi eri kapwaiada dahme KAUN-O mahsanihong ie I en wia. Ni rahno I wiahda ei koruk ehu nin duwen aramas me kin sopohsang nan apwal, oh nin soutiko ni eh wie rotorotpene I ahpw wiahkihda pwoahr ehu pehi kat ni dihdo oh pwediei ie. Nindokon aramas koaros ar kilikilang, I ahpw kidahng koruko pohn pwopwei oh kohkohla.
Mandahn rahno KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, pwehki mehn Israel kahngohdi pwuko ar idihdek rehmw dahme ke wiewia,
ndahng irail dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanihong irail. Mahsen wet iei ong soupeidio me kakaun nan Serusalem oh ong aramas koaros me koukousoan wasao.
Ndahng irail me dahme ke wiahier iei kilel ehu en dahme pahn wiawihong irail—re pahn wiahla aramas me tangatangasang nan apwal oh wiahla aramas selidi kei.
Soupeidi me kakaunirailo pahn wahda eh koruk nan rot oh pwediei nan pwoahr ehu me re pahn wiahda ni kehlo. E pahn perehla mese oh sohte kilang wasa me e kohkolahng ie.
Ahpw I pahn pahkpeseng ei uhk oh lidipihediong loale. I ahpw pahn ketikilahng nan kahnimw Papilon, wasa e pahn mehla ie sohte kilang wasao.
I pahn kamwarakpeseng wasa koaros tohn tehnpese koaros, iangahki sapwellime sounkaweid oh silepe kan, oh aramas akan pahn rapahkin irail pwe re en kemeirailla.
“Ni ei pahn kamwarakirailpeseng nanpwungen wehi teikan oh nan wehin liki kan, re ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi, iei KAUN-O.
I pahn mweidohng pwe me malaulau rehrail en pitsang mahwen oh lehk lapalapo, oh soumwahu kan, pwe re en esehla wasao nanpwungen wehi ko duwen kasaut en ar wiewia kan oh esehla me ngehi, iei KAUN-O.”
Kilel en Sokohp me wie Rerrer
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, rerrer ni omw pahn mwenge, oh rerrerki omw masapwehk ni omw pahn nimpil.

Ndahng wehio pwon me met iei mahsen sang rehn KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ong mehn Serusalem me wie koukousoante nan sapwarailo: Re pahn rerrer ni ar pahn mwenge oh rerrerki ar masepwehk ni ar pahn nimpil. Sapwarailo pahn tehnla, pwehki koaros me koukousoan wasao ar sehse kosonned.
Kahnimw kan me diren aramas met pahn mwomwla, oh sahpwo pahn wiahla sapwtehn. Eri, re ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi, iei KAUN-O.”
Lepin Kahs Ndand oh Mahsen me Kansensuwed
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, dahme mehn Israel kan kin ndindahki lepin kahs wet: ‘Rahn akan imwiseklahr, oh kokohp kan sohte pweida’?

Eri, ndahng irail dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, pahn mahsaniheki duwen met. I pahn katokehdi lepin kahso. Solahr me pahn pwurehng wia kahso nan wehin Israel. Ahpw ke pahn ndahng irail met: Ahnsowo leledohr, oh kokohp kan pahn pweidahr!
“Solahr kaudiahl likamw de kokohp likamw pahn wiawi rehn mehn Israel kan.

Ngehi, KAUN-O, pahn mahseniong irail, oh dahme I pahn mahsanih pahn pweida. Solahr pahn pwapwand. Kumwail kin kahngohdi erein amwail momour, I pahn kapwaiadahr dahme I kahkehlingkihong kumwail me I pahn wia. Ngehi me mahmahsen.” Met iei mahsen en KAUN-O
KAUN-O ketin mahsaniong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, mehn Israel kan lemeleme me omw kaudiahl oh kokohp kan saikinte pahn leledo.
Eri, ndahng irail me ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih: Solahr pahn pwapwand. Dahme I mahsanih pahn pweida. Ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen!”
